competencies.statement: Explain major vehicle-system roles, distinguish observations from diagnostic conclusions, and use safety, professional practice, and technical information to plan an evidence-based next step.
Use observed electrical symptoms and appropriate measurements to plan a vehicle-specific diagnostic check.
Use inspection findings and measurements to diagnose brake-system concerns and verify corrective action.
Interpret operating data and test results to diagnose engine-performance concerns and verify repairs.
Use inspection, geometry, and component evidence to diagnose suspension and steering concerns.
Evaluate complex vehicle-system evidence, uncertainty, competing hypotheses, and verification strategies.
Design and evaluate advanced vehicle-system tests using appropriate instrumentation, controls, and technical evidence.
Design aligned technical curriculum, authentic assessments, rubrics, and feedback systems using measurable outcomes.
Design and evaluate applied technical-education or diagnostic investigations using transparent scholarly evidence.
Use evidence-informed leadership practices to improve technical programs, instruction, learner support, and faculty practice.

Explain electrified-vehicle energy flow, distinguish voltage domains and system roles, and use documented evidence to select safe, vehicle-specific diagnostic next steps without treating one symptom, code, or measurement as proof of component failure.

Recognize automotive shop hazards and professional responsibilities, use applicable safety and environmental information to select a safe next action, and document when work should stop, be controlled, or be escalated.
Apply automotive mathematical relationships with correct units, identify assumptions and required source information, and explain whether a quantitative result is reasonable for the stated problem.
Select an appropriate measurement approach, distinguish a measured value from a specification or conclusion, and document units, instrument context, and source requirements.
Build and evaluate generalized electrical test setups, record measurements with context, and use evidence to justify a safe next diagnostic action.
Explain major engine component and system relationships, distinguish operating evidence from conclusions, and identify when vehicle-specific information is required.

Organize engine laboratory evidence, select appropriate measurement or documentation steps, and recognize when applicable service information is required before a procedure or specification can be used.
Trace generalized drivetrain power flow, identify major subsystem roles, and use observations and applicable information to justify a next inspection or diagnostic question.

Explain generalized HVAC and climate-control relationships, classify operating observations, and identify the applicable information required before interpreting pressures, temperatures, refrigerant handling, or service procedures.
Locate and interpret applicable technical information, distinguish authoritative source content from learner inference, and document the source basis for a diagnostic or service decision.
Analyze advanced engine mechanical relationships, distinguish measured evidence from diagnosis, and identify the applicable service information required before specifications or procedures are used.
Organize engine mechanical laboratory evidence, select an appropriate measurement or inspection approach, and justify a next step using applicable specifications and documented observations.
Collect and interpret generalized engine-performance test evidence, preserve test context and units, and justify a diagnostic next step using applicable technical information.
Explain generalized automatic-transmission power-flow and control relationships, distinguish system evidence from conclusions, and identify applicable information required for diagnosis or service.
Explain electronic signal and control relationships, interpret generalized sensor/actuator evidence, and use applicable technical information to justify a diagnostic next step.
Analyze advanced electrical-system relationships, interpret measurements in operating context, and justify a next diagnostic action using applicable vehicle-specific information.
Organize diagnostic evidence from symptoms, scan data, trouble codes, tests, and applicable information to justify and verify a systematic next diagnostic step.
Plan and document generalized fault-isolation work, collect relevant evidence, and justify a safe next test without substituting assumptions for verified vehicle information.
Explain generalized vehicle-dynamics relationships, apply appropriate quantitative reasoning, and distinguish modeled behavior from vehicle-specific limits or measured evidence.
Explain emissions-system relationships, interpret generalized sensor and system evidence, and identify applicable technical or regulatory information required before diagnostic conclusions are made.
Explain generalized feedback and control relationships, interpret sensor/actuator evidence, and use applicable system information to justify a control-system diagnostic next step.
